messages:
Maya (Product): Quick design review — roles grid + invite flow. Two things to look at: SSO toggle microcopy and keyboard navigation in the roles table. Screenshots in Drive: https://drive.redwood/example-screenshots
AJ (Designer): Saw the screenshots, thanks. For the SSO copy I'm debating: "Require SSO for invites" vs "Restrict invites to SSO users" — which reads clearer?
Sam (Eng): Engineering leaning toward shorter verb phrase. "Enforce SSO for invites" matches our event names (`org.sso.invite_enforced`).
Lia (A11y): From a11y perspective: toggle should be role="switch" with `aria-checked` (or use `aria-pressed` if we keep button semantics). Suggested full label: "Require single sign-on to accept organization invites". Keep visible hint text too.
AJ (Designer): Good call. Also the roles grid currently wraps role names to two lines which breaks small screens. Proposal: single-line with ellipsis + tooltip on hover; ensure tooltip also appears on focus for keyboard users.
Maya (Product): Also an audit-log navigation pain: folks can't jump from an invite event to admin actions quickly. Idea: add filter chips at top: "Invites", "Role changes", "SSO events" and a quick link on each row to "View related action".
Sam (Eng): Filter chips OK. Perf note: don't fetch full user profile for every row by default — lazy-load details when row expanded or when "View related action" clicked. We'll expose a small API flag `includeUserDetails=false`.
AJ (Designer): Copy in invite modal: current CTA is "Send invite" — some PMs asked to make it explicit "Send invite and notify via email" but that may be too long. Suggest: keep CTA "Send invite" + supporting copy below: "Invited users will receive an email unless SSO is required."
Lia (A11y): Agree keep CTA short. But ensure the supporting copy is programmatically associated with the button (aria-describedby) so screen readers read it when focusing the button. Also ensure tooltip accessible via keyboard.
DesignBot (bot): Accessibility check: primary button contrast drops below 4.5:1 on hover state — recommend color token update.
Sam (Eng): Noted. We'll update hover token and add lazy load for user details; also expose API flag as mentioned.
AJ (Designer): I'll update Figma with ellipsis + tooltip behavior, provide CSS pattern and keyboard focus state. Adding microcopy for the SSO toggle and the invite supporting text.
Maya (Product): Awesome. Action items: AJ -> updated mocks by EOD, Lia -> aria labels & voice read examples, Sam -> API note + perf plan, I'll schedule a 15m sync if needed.
Lia (A11y): Quick nit: keyboard users should be able to open tooltip with Enter/Space when row focused. Add that to the spec.
AJ (Designer): Will do.
Maya (Product): Thanks all :thumbsup:
